# Biotide

> A daily biorhythm chart and energy tracker for iPhone and iPad that tests the three cycles against how you feel, with compatibility and best days.

## What is Biotide?

Biotide is a daily biorhythm chart and energy tracker for iPhone and iPad that tests the three cycles against how you feel, with compatibility and best days. Made by Biotide. This file is the plain-text summary for AI agents; every page below also has a Markdown mirror at its URL plus `.md`.

## Privacy

- No Biotide account
- Data stays on the device
- On the website, Google Analytics runs under a regional consent banner (opt-in in the EEA, opt-out elsewhere). Cookieless aggregate page-view counting (Cloudflare Web Analytics) uses no cookies or identifiers.
